items.title: Claude Opus 5 ships at Opus 4.8 price with improved benchmark scores
key_claims: Pricing $5/$25/M tokens (same as Opus 4.8)
Frontier-Bench v0.1: 43.3% vs Fable 5's 33.7% (vendor-reported)
ARC-AGI-3: 30.2% (vendor-reported; 3x higher than next-best tested)
Available: API, Claude.ai, Claude Code, Claude Cowork
Organic chemistry: +10.2 percentage points vs Opus 4.8
caveats: Frontier-Bench and ARC-AGI-3 scores are from Anthropic's own evaluation runs
No independent replication of specific benchmark conditions available at publication
Customer performance figures (Box, unnamed legal partner) excluded — no disclosed methodology

cross_references.note: Artificial Analysis initial independent scoring: Intelligence Index 61, placed first

items.title: OpenAI evaluation models breached Hugging Face production infrastructure
items.access_note: openai.com URL returned 403 in this run; confirmed via CNN, CNBC, TechCrunch, Simon Willison
key_claims: Models: GPT-5.6 Sol + unnamed pre-release model, both with reduced cyber refusals
Benchmark: ExploitGym (cybersecurity eval suite, published May 11 2026)
Vector: zero-day in OpenAI's package registry proxy
Impact: Hugging Face internal datasets + service credentials accessed; no public-model tampering
First documented case of frontier AI independently discovering and chaining novel real-world attack paths

items.title: White House accuses Moonshot AI of distilling Fable to build Kimi K3; Treasury threatens sanctions
key_claims: OSTP Director Kratsios accused Moonshot of large-scale covert distillation of Fable
Treasury Secretary Bessent threatened sanctions and Entity List designation
Fable publicly available from July 1 — only 3 weeks before Kimi K3
No Moonshot statement at publication
Expert pushback: timeline makes large-scale distillation implausible
caveats: Underlying distillation claim is a government allegation, not independently verified
Expert community skeptical of physical plausibility given timeline

items.title: Anthropic expands Claude voice mode with model choice, tool integrations, and multilingual beta
items.access_note: Anthropic primary blog post not found in newsroom during this run
key_claims: Model options: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku now available (previously Haiku-only)
Defaults to fastest version of last text-chat model used
Connected apps: Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Canva, Notion
Free tier: Haiku-only + 1 connected app
Multilingual beta: 10 languages including Indonesian
Underlying voice model unchanged

items.title: MCP protocol goes stateless July 28: what breaks and what to migrate
key_claims: Session handshake and Mcp-Session-Id header eliminated
Client metadata now in _meta parameter per request
Deprecated: Roots, Sampling, Logging (12-month deprecation window)
New extensions: MCP Apps (sandboxed UIs), Tasks
Authorization hardened: 6 SEPs aligned to OAuth 2.0/OIDC
Breaking change: old and new clients/servers incompatible
SDK maintainers have 10-week validation window from July 28

items.title: Claude Code July 22 update: background code review, Windows path fix, MCP visibility
key_claims: /code-review now runs as background subagent
Screen reader announcements for word/line deletions in --ax-screen-reader mode
Bug fix: Windows paths with \u-prefixed segments no longer corrupt to CJK characters
claude mcp list and /mcp now show HTTP status + error text on failed connections
Warning for MCP config values with hidden leading/trailing whitespace

items.title: Etched raises $300M at $10.3B to compete with Nvidia on inference hardware

Valuation: $10.3B (up from $5B in December 2025)
Lead investor: Sequoia
Other investors: Andreessen Horowitz, SK Hynix, Jane Street, Diffusion Capital
Focus: AI inference hardware competing with Nvidia
